name: AppShell
description: Compose application navigation, a top bar and a workspace, with optional section drawer, inspector and phone navigation.
signature: ({ brand, rail, drawer, topBar, children, inspector, tabBar, drawerShortcut, className, }: AppShellProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: brand
props.description: Top-left corner, above the rail: the product mark (ShellBrand).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: drawer
props.description: The current section's navigation (SectionDrawer). Optional per section.

props.name: drawerShortcut
props.description: Toggle the drawer from the keyboard. Default mod+b.

props.name: inspector
props.description: Context pane (Inspector), docked beside the workspace on wide screens.
